subject: Kickoff: Vendor setup & PO rules for Horizon Analytics engagement
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Larson <sara.larson@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Vendor setup & PO rules for Horizon Analytics engagement

Hi Sara / Horizon procurement team,

Thanks for kicking this off. We're excited to get the pilot live with Horizon Analytics. Before we move forward I want to align on a few procurement/vendor-setup items so there aren't surprises when we invoice: 

- PO requirement: do you require a purchase order for the initial pilot engagement, or only for renewals/committed contracts? If yes, please confirm the PO number format you expect (e.g., PO-YYYY-#####) and whether a separate PO is required per SOW or a master PO is acceptable.
- PO issuance timeline: what is your typical lead time from receiving signed SOW and completed vendor onboarding packet to issuing the PO?
- Invoice remit / tax: confirm remit address, required tax forms (W-9 / W-8BEN), and whether you require ACH details up front.
- Line-item structure: we typically ship SOWs with 1) SKU/line code, 2) short description, 3) unit, 4) quantity, 5) unit price, 6) total, and 7) account/cost-center string. Does Horizon need additional columns (e.g., service period, milestone%)? Any preferred CSV template?

I've attached the Redwood vendor onboarding form and the current SOW draft so your team can see the proposed line-item breakdown. Marissa (cc'd) owns vendor setup on our side — please return the completed onboarding form + signed SOW to Marissa and cc me. If you prefer, you can also upload documents to the vendor portal link your team uses and copy Marissa.

Goal: get vendor set up and PO issued so we can start onboarding services by April 1.

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-minute call if it helps.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments (mentioned): Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Form.pdf, SOW_Redwood-Horizon_v1.2.docx

From: Sara Larson <sara.larson@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@horizon-analytics.com, Alan Cho <alan.cho@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 13:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor setup & PO rules for Horizon Analytics engagement

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear list. A few quick answers from Procurement: 

- PO requirement: Horizon requires a PO for any vendor spend above $5,000. For pilots under $5k we can accept an invoice and process payment, but renewals or multi-month commitments will need a PO.
- PO format & scope: we prefer one master PO per vendor relationship where possible, then reference SOW numbers on invoices. If you need a PO per SOW, we can do that too — but it typically adds 1 extra business day to processing.
- Typical timeline: once we have a completed onboarding packet, completed tax form (W-9 for US entities), and a countersigned SOW, PO issuance is usually 7-10 business days. Faster if all ACH/bank info is already validated in our vendor portal.
- Line-items: we can accept either per-SOW line items or consolidated monthly invoice lines. For our AP team we prefer description + service period + invoice-level reference to the SOW (SOW ID) so they can match.

I'll have Alan from my team open a vendor portal invite for you. Please send the completed onboarding form and W-9 to procurement@horizon-analytics.com and cc Marissa so we can correlate the request.

Regards,
Sara Larson
Sr. Procurement Manager | Horizon Analytics
sara.larson@horizon-analytics.com

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor setup & PO rules for Horizon Analytics engagement

Thanks Sara — that's helpful. A couple clarifications from our side so your AP team has what it needs: 

- Redwood policy: we prefer to have a PO in place for any engagement where there is ongoing spend; for the pilot (estimated <$10k) we can be flexible and accept an invoice to get started, but we'll require a PO prior to any renewal or implementation of Dedicated capacity.
- Preferred line-item template: SKU / SOW-ID | Description (short) | Service period (MM/DD/YYYY - MM/DD/YYYY) | Unit (e.g., hr / license / month) | Qty | Unit price | Total | Account code / Cost center. Example CSV link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBxyProcureOnboard
- PO issuance (Redwood expectation): if Marissa receives the completed onboarding form + W-9 + signed SOW and Alan's portal verification completes, we typically see a PO from Horizon in 3-7 business days (your 7-10 timing is understood — appreciate the note).

Marissa — when you get the completed packet from Horizon, can you: 1) open a Redwood vendor ticket, 2) confirm bank details, and 3) flag the SOW ID so we can match invoices to the PO?

If Horizon prefers a single master PO referencing SOW IDs on invoices that's fine — we just need the PO number in the invoice header for AP matching.

Happy to hop on a quick call to finalize the onboarding CSV if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Karthik
